# Citizen Sustainable

> Research-based sustainability guides exploring environmental impacts of everyday products and practices with eco-friendly alternatives.

Citizen Sustainable provides evidence-based content on environmental sustainability, consumer products, and green living practices. The site is run by a team including Aisling O'Connor, Aisha Williams, and Savanna Stanfield, and has been featured in major media outlets including NPR, iHeart Radio, and Bustle.

## Key Topics

- Environmental Impact
- Sustainability
- Eco-Friendly Alternatives
- Recycling
- Green Living
- Sustainable Materials
- Climate Change
- Air Pollution
- Consumer Education
- EVA (Ethylene-Vinyl Acetate)
- EPA Guidelines
- Environmental Facts
- Gardening Sustainability
- Packaging Materials
- Eco-Friendly Living

## Core Pages

- [Citizen Sustainable – Research-Based Sustainability](https://citizensustainable.com): Homepage for Citizen Sustainable's research-based sustainability content and eco-friendly product guides.
- [Welcome to CitizenSustainable](https://citizensustainable.com/about): About page introducing CitizenSustainable team including O'Connor, Williams, and Stanfield.
- [In the Media, Press & Research](https://citizensustainable.com/press-media): Press coverage and media mentions from NPR, iHeart Radio, Bustle, and other publications.

## Materials & Packaging

- [Is EVA Eco-Friendly? 14 Facts You Should Know (+3 Alternatives)](https://citizensustainable.com/eva-recyclable): Comprehensive guide to EVA ethylene-vinyl acetate recyclability and material alternatives.
- [Is Recyclable Packaging More Expensive? (With Cost Comparison)](https://citizensustainable.com/recyclable-packaging-expensive): Cost comparison of recyclable packaging materials like aluminum, cardboard, and glass.
- [Is Fabric Softener Bad for the Environment? (+5 Eco-Friendly Options)](https://citizensustainable.com/fabric-softener): Guide to fabric softener environmental impact with eco-friendly alternatives like Ecover.
- [Is Diamond Mining Bad for the Environment? (Important Facts)](https://citizensustainable.com/diamond-mining): Environmental facts on diamond mining methods and synthetic diamond alternatives.

## Environmental Impact & Emissions

- [Is Fast Food Bad for the Environment? (& What You Can Do)](https://citizensustainable.com/fast-food-environment): Environmental impact guide on fast food waste and packaging by Aisha Williams.
- [Is Fuel Dumping Bad for the Environment? (& How Often It Happens)](https://citizensustainable.com/fuel-dumping): Analysis of aviation fuel jettison environmental impact and FAA regulations.
- [Is Burning Paper Bad for the Environment? (6 Surprising Facts)](https://citizensustainable.com/burning-paper): Analysis of paper burning emissions and recycling alternatives by Aisha Williams.
- [Is Burning Leaves Bad for the Environment? (7 Quick Facts)](https://citizensustainable.com/burning-leaves): Environmental impact of leaf burning and eco-friendly disposal alternatives.

## Gardening & Outdoor Sustainability

- [Are Grow Bags Eco-Friendly? 11 Important Facts You Should Know](https://citizensustainable.com/grow-bags-eco-friendly): Sustainability analysis of polypropylene grow bags versus raised beds and plastic pots.
- [Does Radon Affect Gardening? 5 Important Facts (+6 Practical Tips)](https://citizensustainable.com/radon-gardening): Radon health risks in gardening with EPA and CDC guidelines and mitigation tips.
